Title: Why GLP-1 Weight Loss Drugs Cause Hair Loss

Description:
Noticed more hair coming out since starting Ozempic, Wegovy, or Mounjaro? Clinical trials confirm it - hair loss showed up in about 3% of Wegovy users versus 1% on placebo, and up to 5.7% on Mounjaro versus under 1% on placebo. Rapid weight loss, nutrient gaps, and nausea blocking absorption are the three drivers. Slowing your rate of weight loss and prioritizing protein, iron, and zinc-rich foods helps follicles recover - growth typically resumes once weight stabilizes.
